items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: We used to grow up there and whip him out, me and Bichet.

ctx.x: Yeah. Would you say he played a lot of blues, Johnny Dives?
Johnny Dives played a lot of blues. We used to grow up there and whip him out, me and Bichet.
Was he scared of y'all or were you scared of him?
